title: Template
intro: A minimal package around a stand-in CLI: request.json read with jq, instructions into AGENTS.md, the CLI's output mapped onto Responses events by map.py. Fork it to start a package of your own.

verified.how: hg harness run, two turns, the stand-in CLI

notes: Set defaults.provider to a provider you registered and defaults.model to a model it serves.
install.sh runs unprivileged in the base image; put the CLI under $HG_TOOLS.
map.py is the whole mapping; the item shapes are the SDK's and the platform validates them.
response.sh is optional: add one to shape the final response yourself instead of letting the events decide.
